'''Mirrian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Mirrian lived in her [[Wolff Kalos's family|parent's]] old home. She was the sister of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Wolff Kalos]].<ref name="SWG:FtE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Leave me alone. You won't get what you want from me.''"<br />"''If you won't tell me, perhaps your sister might.''"<br />"''I beg your pardon?''"<br />"''Your sister, Mirrian who lives in your parent's old home.''"<br />"''You monster! You wouldn't hurt my family!|[[Wolff Kalos]] and an Imperial spacer|<ref name="SWG:FtE" />}}
Mirrian was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FtE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Mirrian was mentioned during the fourth chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" questline,<ref name="SWG:FtE" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>

In the fourth quest of the "Secrets of the Syren" arc, the player had to choose to work with either Wolff Kalos or [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]]. This article assumes that the player was affiliated the Rebel Alliance. If the player instead chose the Empire, the player would have to threaten Mirrian to obtain information from Wolff Kalos.<ref name="SWG:FtE" />
